Subject: Request: PO-anchored invoicing and temporary credit increase

Jonas,

Thanks for the great conversations last week. We’re close to finalizing the pilot SOW but need a couple of billing accommodations to proceed:

- Can Redwood accept PO-anchored invoicing? Our procurement team will issue POs that reference line items and milestones; we want invoices to reference the PO and for payment terms to start on PO acceptance rather than service start for certain milestones.
- We need a temporary uplift of the credit limit from $50k to $140k while we spin up the pilot (approx. 60–90 days). The uplift is necessary to cover the initial committed consumption.
- VAT handling: BluePeak will be billed out of our US HQ for this purchase, but we need Redwood to include VAT/Tax registration numbers on invoices if any EU entity is involved later.

Can you confirm if Redwood can do: PO-anchored invoices + Net45 on PO acceptance (pilot only) + a temporary credit cap increase? If you have a standard amendment we can route to procurement, please attach.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — procurement wants the PO ready by next Tuesday.

Best,
Tom Reed
CFO, BluePeak Systems
procurement@bluepeak.com

Subject: Re: Request: PO-anchored invoicing and temporary credit increase

Tom — thanks, and appreciate the clarity. Quick summary of what we can offer and open items: 

1) PO-anchored invoicing: we can reference the customer PO number on invoices and accept the PO as the billing trigger for milestone invoices. For subscription/consumption billing we typically invoice on calendar cycles, but for milestone/PO lines we can start the payment term on PO acceptance.

2) Terms: for the pilot we can make the milestone/PO invoices Net45 from PO acceptance. For recurring consumption invoices we propose Net30 as default. If you prefer all invoices Net45 for pilot, we’ll need sign-off from finance (see internal thread below).

3) Temporary credit uplift: we can provisionally increase the credit cap, contingent on: a signed PO per milestone (PO must reference invoice lines), a short KYC (standard credit check) and receipt of VAT / tax registration evidence if applicable. Suggested provisional cap: $150,000 for 90 days.

4) VAT / tax: please send any EU VAT registration numbers or US tax forms (W-9/W-8) for the billing entity; we will reflect these on invoices. If an EU entity becomes the billed party, we’ll follow reverse-charge rules and include the VAT ID as required.

I’m attaching a short draft amendment that captures PO-anchored invoicing and the provisional credit uplift. Can you route that to procurement for redlines?

- Jonas
VP, Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Attachments: standard-amendment-draft.pdf (PDF stub)

Jonas — I’m fine with a provisional increase under the following controlled conditions: 

1) Increase credit cap to $150,000 for 90 days, subject to:
   - Receipt of executed milestone PO(s) that explicitly reference invoice lines,
   - A one-time credit check (finance to run),
   - A first-milestone partial prepayment of 25% or placement of the first milestone into escrow with an approved escrow agent.

2) Invoice cadence and terms:
   - Milestone/PO invoices: Net45 from date of PO acceptance (PO must be attached to the invoice).
   - Consumption/subscription invoices: Net30 from invoice date (standard cadence).

3) VAT/tax evidence: require the billing entity’s tax/VAT ID before the uplift is effective. If BluePeak supplies only a US HQ PO but later routes invoices to an EU affiliate, we’ll add reverse-charge language and require the EU VAT ID.

4) Approval / operational steps: finance will run the credit check and update the account cap. Contracts should include a 90-day review clause that reverts the cap to $50k unless renewed. Contract to be executed via DocuSign; Ops to configure PO-reference field in billing metadata so invoices automatically include the PO number.

I’ll prepare a short amendment clause and a DocuSign envelope template. Happy to approve on legal’s sign-off; for speed, include a clause that the uplift is contingent on receipts listed above.

Marissa
Head of Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference
